images.title: Mira's puzzle: subtract and repeat
images.purpose: Show the first step of Mira's puzzle: two numbers made from 3 and 7, and their difference.
images.composition: A column subtraction of 73 minus 37 centred on white with the digits 3 and 7 shown on two coloured cards on the left.
images.exact_structure: On the left two square cards, one with digit 3 in #0072B2 and one with digit 7 in #E69F00. In the centre a vertical subtraction: 73 on the first line, 37 on the second line with a minus sign at the left, a horizontal line, and 36 below the line. A curved arrow in #CC79A7 leaves the 36 and points to two new small cards showing 3 and 6 on the right, labelled 'use these two digits next'.
